title: Aktau bus drivers refuse routes over wages and working conditions
reason: The observed action is a work stoppage/route non-operation, not a documented public gathering of at least 50 people, and reported demands concern wages, meals/working conditions and employer treatment rather than a state policy demand.
notes: 24KZ reports 63 drivers did not go on routes and around 60 buses were idle; these are not attendee counts. Management/officials met the drivers and service resumed. No evidence the drivers assembled simultaneously.
